sloka: वेदिं च दक्षिणप्राच्यां यथास्थानं च पावकम् ।पृषदाज्येन सम्पूर्णं स्रुवं सर्वे प्रचिक्षिपुः ।। ६.११४.१०६ ।।
transliteration: vediṁ ca dakṣiṇaprācyāṁ yathāsthānaṁ ca pāvakam ।pṛṣadājyena sampūrṇaṁ sruvaṁ sarve pracikṣipuḥ ।। 6.114.106 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana arranged to get excellent carts, fires maintained by Ravana, priests, so also sandalwood, and many kinds of wood, fragrant perfumes, sandals, sweet smelling odours, gems, pearls, and corals and proceeded with obsequies.
